correctness.rationale: A d-query response table for two-literal OR yields pairwise coordinate-column OR; this is an iff condition. Two zero and all d unit columns are obligatory; the detailed weight-three counting excludes four extras at d=5, and a 56<64 argument excludes d=6 with n<=12. Adaptive lower bounds use 5 complete query trees with 62 distinct leaves for depths 1..5 at n=3,4,5,7,10. Each leaf answer pattern was independently re-evaluated using actual certificates.json. For n=9 and n=12, triangular zero-branch counts exclude the cardinality ceiling; otherwise cardinality upper bounds match. Independent program enumerated all 17,902 sets of <=4 extras at d=5 and validated all 62 tree leaves.
